summary: Validated the PIX copy button fix end-to-end on the preview (HTTPS). Full flow: /campanha-pernambuco -> Fazer doação -> R$ 50 -> CONTINUAR -> Doar anonimamente -> /doacao/pix. Clicked data-testid='copy-pix-code-button'. Confirmed via navigator.clipboard.readText() that the PIX code (140 chars, starts with 00020101021226440014br.gov.bcb.pix0122danielmmm950@gmail.com...) is placed in the clipboard. Icon changes to Check state on click and reverts after ~2s. No 'Não foi possível copiar' alert appeared. Backend PATCH /api/admin/donations/{id} persisted copied=true - verified via admin login (donas/Seinao10@@) that the latest donation has copied=true.
critical_code_review_comments: handleCopyCode fallback path (execCommand) is not exercised in HTTPS preview context; on real HTTP deployments it will run - implementation looks correct (textarea + focus + select + execCommand + cleanup). Consider suppressing the alert on double-failure with a less intrusive toast for better UX.
PixPaymentPage.jsx is a single file - if it grows further (>500 lines) split into hooks/components.
seed_data_creation: Created one anonymous donation R$50 (donation_id=1785870140462) via the normal donation flow; it was correctly marked copied=true after click.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PIX copy button on /doacao/pix is confirmed working in HTTPS preview. Fallback path for HTTP was not exercised (window.isSecureContext=true in preview) - it can only be tested on the real HTTP host http://64.23.180.248:8500. The MongoDB PIX key is danielmmm950@gmail.com. Anonymous donations produce empty donor fields but copied flag is updated correctly.
rca of the issue: Original bug: navigator.clipboard.writeText requires secure context (HTTPS/localhost). On HTTP host it silently fails. Fix in PixPaymentPage.jsx handleCopyCode wraps the call in try/catch and uses a textarea+execCommand('copy') fallback when !window.isSecureContext or navigator.clipboard is missing. Verified end-to-end that HTTPS path works and code is persisted (copied=true) via PATCH /api/admin/donations/{id}.
